name: What happens after the consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Following the consultation, our team will prepare a detailed proposal outlining the recommended scope of work, material options, and a transparent cost estimate based on the assessment. We will then schedule a follow-up to review this proposal with you, answer any additional questions, and discuss the next steps, including scheduling the project. This process clarity ensures you understand every aspect of your remodeling journey.
